licence_note: Facts from each event's source page; please cite Little Westies (littlewesties.au) and the url. null = not stated by the source.

items.name: One Moana Festival x Le Makete
items.description: A Pasifika pop-up market with food, makers and small businesses. Free entry.

items.name: Annunciation, Corpus Christi & St Augustines Community Fair
items.price: Free entry (ride wristbands $40 on the day)
items.description: A school fair with rides, stalls, music, food, raffles, AFL and soccer workshops and a visit from the SES. Entry is free. Ride wristbands are $40 on the day; early-bird pricing ended 9 November. Rides are for children from kinder to Grade 6, with a minimum age of 3 and a maximum height of 150 cm. Dogs are not permitted, except registered assistance animals.

items.name: Rhyme Time
items.description: A 30-minute session of stories, songs, actions and rhymes. You must have a child aged 1–5 years.

items.name: Family Tales
items.venue: Caroline Springs Library and Learning Hub
items.description: Stories, songs and rhymes for families. No booking needed.

items.name: Diwali Milan
items.description: Cultural performances, food, activities and stalls, presented by the Association of Rajasthani Australian Inc. Bookings are closed and tickets are sold out.

items.name: Science Studio – Taking Flight
items.price: Adult $30 (includes general entry); child 16 and under $35
items.description: A hands-on STEM workshop on the science of flight, with six activities and a take-home booklet. Children must be accompanied by an adult who also needs a ticket. Member tickets: adult $10, child $28.

items.name: Outwest Concrete Wyndham Retro Motor Show
items.price: Adult $5 (12 years and over); children under 12 free
items.description: Classic and custom cars, live music, food trucks and family-friendly activities, raising funds for mental health services at Werribee Mercy Hospital. Proudly supported by Wyndham City Council.

items.name: Govardhan & Diwali Celebration
items.description: A family Diwali celebration with children's activities, a cultural drama, food stalls, free prasadam, Govardhan Parikrama at 3:30pm and Grand Arati at 5pm. Free registration is required and is capped at 30.

items.name: Diwali Kids Adventure: Govardhan Hill Holy Places Hunt
items.description: A treasure hunt around the castle grounds with an adventure map and a prize for the winner. Free registration is required and is capped at 30.

excluded.name: Queer As! Brimbank (Sat 14 Nov, Sunshine)
excluded.reason: For people aged 18 and over, not a kids' event.

excluded.name: What was that! Night theatre at Werribee Park
excluded.reason: Recommended for ages 11 and over, and the organiser says it has scary elements.
